scope.summary: Implement the local/native plugin registry (discover, install, update, remove) - NOT a runtime dependency on any vendor hosted marketplace/account - and plugin dev tooling (typed stubs, hot reload, developer console). Importing a source suite's plugin ecosystem is out of scope; the manifest/capability/consent contract is the Studio-native model, preserving the local-first no-account posture.
acceptance_criteria: local plugin registry (install/update/remove) + dev tooling; no hosted marketplace/account runtime dep
proof_targets: local install/update/remove runtime test; no-hosted-dependency audit
expected_tests: live: install/update/remove a plugin from the local registry
negative: no hosted marketplace/account dependency at runtime
argus: plugin manager reachable by author_id

risk_if_missed: Plugin distribution depends on a hosted marketplace/account; local-first posture broken.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
